cues: Haloalkanes show chain isomerism, position isomerism, and optical isomerism.
C four H nine B r has exactly four structural isomers, asked year after year: one bromobutane, two bromobutane, one bromo two methyl propane, and two bromo two methyl propane.
Two bromobutane also has a carbon carrying four different groups, so it exists as a pair of mirror image optical isomers.
